title: He started at P&G in 1989 as an assistant brand manager. In January 2026, he became its CEO.

sources.text: P&G / SEC EDGAR, July 28, 2025 - CEO transition press release
Business Standard, July 29, 2025 - Shailesh Jejurikar becomes first Indian to lead 187-year-old P&G

caption:
He started at P&G in 1989 as an assistant brand manager. In January 2026, he became its CEO.

On July 28, 2025, P&G announced Jejurikar - then Chief Operating Officer - would become President and CEO effective January 1, 2026, the first India-born chief executive in the company's roughly 188-year history.

Born in Mumbai, Jejurikar studied at Elphinstone College and IIM Lucknow before joining P&G in 1989 on a personal healthcare brand in India. He rose through Fabric Care, Home Care and regional leadership roles over 36 years before reaching the top job - and in August 2026 was also named Chairman of the Board.

The man who started on the lowest rung of P&G's brand ladder in India now runs the company behind Tide, Pampers and Gillette - and holds both the CEO and Chairman title at once.
